blocks.text: With these preliminaries, we shall now try to interpret the whole verse. In Hebrew it reads thus: כנף רננים נעלסה אם אברה חסידה ונוצה, which we render word for word as follows: The wing of the ostriches exults, truly the wing of the stork, and the plumage: that is, which is truly a wing and plumage such as in the stork. The particle אם im is mostly the same as IF, or is a mark of interrogation, like WHETHER, ἄρα [ara], πότερον [poteron]; but also, as Kimchi points out, ויש שהוא כמו האמת. It also occurs for TRULY, and is a particle of affirmation, as if formed from אמן, amen, with the Nun dropped, as in אמת for אמנת ^{(2)}. Examples of this meaning are found at Gen. XLVII, 18. Num. XVI, 30. Iob XXII, 20. Psal. LIX, 16. and LXIII, 7. Prov. III, 34. and XXIII, 18. Es. IV, 4. and XXIX, 16. etc. The wing of the stork, אברה חסידה, for אברת חסידה: the absolute state for the construct, which is not without examples. Thus Deut. XVI, 21. אשרה כל עץ, a grove of any tree, for אשרת. Ruth. II, 17. איפה שערים, an ephah of barley, for איפת. 2 Reg. VII, 1. סאה סולת, a seah of fine flour, for סאת. Psal. XLV, 5. וענוה צדק, and of the meekness of righteousness, for וענות. Es. XXIV, 22. אספה אסיר, with the gathering of a prisoner, for אספת. Es. XLII, 25. חמה אפו, the heat of his anger, for חמת. These Kimchi in his Commentaries repeatedly explains by ellipsis, as if one said אשרה אשרת כל עץ, a grove, a grove, I say, of any tree: [col. 248] as when we read at Exod. XXXVIII, 21. אלה פקודי המשכן משכן העדה, These are the things numbered of the tabernacle, of the tabernacle of the testimony. And Num. XXXII, 1. המקום מקום מקנה, the place, a place of cattle. And Psal. CXXXIII, 2. על הזקן זקן אהרן, upon the beard, the beard of Aaron. And Ezech. XLVII, 3. במים מי אפסים, in the waters, waters of the ankles. So in the passage we are dealing with, if the expression were complete, it would read אברה אברת חסידה, a wing, a wing, I say, of the stork: or, if you prefer, one may supply כף דמיון, the Caph of similitude, so that אברה חסידה stands for אברה כחסידה, a wing like that of the stork. Expressions of this kind occur everywhere. As Gen. XLIX, 9. Judah, a lion's whelp. And Deut. XXXIII, 22. Dan, a lion's whelp, that is, like a lion's whelp. Gen. XLIX, 14. Issachar, a strong ass, that is, like an ass. Deut. XXVIII, 23. Your heavens bronze, the earth iron, that is, like bronze, like iron. 2 Sam. I, 21. The shield of Saul not anointed, that is, as if not anointed. Iob VII, 9. The cloud has vanished and gone, so he who goes down to the grave, etc. Has vanished [II, 852] כלה, for ככלה, as it vanished. Iob. XI, 12. Man is born a wild ass, that is, like a wild ass. Psal. XI, 1. How do you say to my soul, that it should flee from your mountain צפור, a bird, that is, כצפור, like a bird. Psal. XIV, 4. Eating my people, they eat bread, that is, as they eat bread. Psal. CXIX, 119. You have removed all the wicked of the earth as dross, that is, like dross. Proverb. XVII, 22. A merry heart ייטב גהה, does good, a medicine, that is, כגהה, like a medicine. Cant. I, 15. Your eyes doves', that is, like doves'. Can. VII, 5. Your eyes the pools in Heshbon, for like the pools. Thren. IV, 7. Their polish sapphires, that is, like sapphires. Mich. III, 12. Zion shall be ploughed a field, for like a field.
